```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

#uncomment if the libraries has not been installed before

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(scales)
```

# Data collection

```{r data_input}
coffee <- read_csv('../data/coffee_survey.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Data Preperation

```{r}
age_levels <- c(
  "<18 years old",
  "18-24 years old",
  "25-34 years old",
  "35-44 years old",
  "45-54 years old",
  "55-64 years old",
  ">65 years old"
)

#Others genders will be excluded, since they are a minority of the data and add visual clutter with no meaningful information able to be extracted from them
gender_levels <- c("Male", "Female", "Non-binary")

# Convert spending ranges to approximate dollar values
spending_values <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    x == "<$20"       ~ 10,
    x == "$20-$40"    ~ 30,
    x == "$40-$60"    ~ 50,
    x == "$60-$80"    ~ 70,
    x == "$80-$100"   ~ 90,
    x == ">$100"      ~ 110,
    TRUE              ~ NA_real_
  )
}

# Prepare shared variables without requiring education data
coffee_q2 <- coffee %>%
  transmute(
    age = factor(age, levels = age_levels),
    gender = gender,
    education_level = education_level,
    total_spend_numeric = spending_values(total_spend)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(age),
    !is.na(total_spend_numeric)
  )

# Dataset for Plot 1: age and gender
# Missing education values do not exclude respondents here
coffee_gender <- coffee_q2 %>%
  filter(gender %in% gender_levels) %>%
  mutate(
    gender_group = factor(gender, levels = gender_levels)
  )

# Dataset for Plots 2 and 3: age and education
# Only these plots require a non-missing education level
coffee_education <- coffee_q2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(education_level))

# Useful sample sizes for the report
n_gender <- nrow(coffee_gender)
n_education <- nrow(coffee_education)

cat("Respondents used for gender analysis:", n_gender, "\n")
cat("Respondents used for education analysis:", n_education, "\n")
```


```{r}
# Plot 1: Mean spending by age and gender ------------------------------------

age_gender_mean <- coffee_gender %>%
  group_by(age, gender_group, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_spend = if (all(is.na(total_spend_numeric))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(total_spend_numeric, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    n = sum(!is.na(total_spend_numeric)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    bar_label = paste0(
      "$", round(mean_spend),
      "\n(n=", n, ")"
    )
  )

gender_colors <- c(
  "Male" = "lightblue",
  "Female" = "pink",
  "Non-binary" = "purple"
)

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.85)

plot1 <- ggplot(
  age_gender_mean,
  aes(
    x = age,
    y = mean_spend,
    fill = gender_group
  )
) +
  # Dashed separators between age groups
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = seq(1.5, length(age_levels) - 0.5, by = 1),
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray60",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.85),
    width = 0.75
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = gender_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Coffee Spending by Age Group and Gender",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Mean Spending per Respondent ($)",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
ggsave("../final_plots/q2_coffee_spending_by_age_and_gender.png", plot1,
       width = 13, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)

plot1
```


```{r}
# Plot 2: Mean spending by age and education

age_education_average <- coffee_education %>%
  group_by(age, education_level, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  summarise(
    average_spending = if (all(is.na(total_spend_numeric))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      mean(total_spend_numeric, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    n = sum(!is.na(total_spend_numeric)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n > 0)

plot2 <- ggplot(
  age_education_average,
  aes(
    x = age,
    y = average_spending,
    color = education_level,
    group = education_level
  )
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_point(size = 2, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Coffee Spending by Age and Education",
    subtitle = "Labels and points represent observed age-education groups",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Mean Monthly Spending per Respondent ($)",
    color = "Education Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
ggsave("../final_plots/q2_coffee_spending_by_age_and_education.png", plot2,
       width = 13, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)
plot2
```


```{r}
# Plot 3: Highlight doctorate or professional degree

highlight_label <- "Doctorate or professional degree"

age_education_highlight <- age_education_average %>%
  mutate(
    highlighted = if_else(
      education_level == highlight_label,
      highlight_label,
      "Other Education Levels"
    )
  )

highlight_colors <- c(
  "Doctorate or professional degree" = "purple",
  "Other Education Levels" = "gray70"
)

plot3 <- ggplot(
  age_education_highlight,
  aes(
    x = age,
    y = average_spending,
    group = education_level,
    color = highlighted
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(linewidth = highlighted),
    alpha = 0.9,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = highlighted),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = highlight_colors) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(
    values = c(
      "Doctorate or professional degree" = 1.4,
      "Other Education Levels" = 0.7
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_size_manual(
    values = c(
      "Doctorate or professional degree" = 3,
      "Other Education Levels" = 1.8
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Coffee Spending by Age and Education",
    subtitle = "Doctorate or professional degree highlighted",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Mean Monthly Spending per Respondent ($)",
    color = "Education Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
ggsave("../final_plots/q2_coffee_spending_by_age_and_education_highlighted.png", plot3,
       width = 13, height = 6.5, dpi = 300)

plot3
```
